title: 949. Minimum Area Rectangle II

examples.explanation: The four points are the corners of a tilted square whose area is 2.
Points (1,0), (1,1), (2,0) and (2,1) outline a unit square of area 1.
No four of these points form a rectangle, so the answer is 0.

hints: Two segments are a rectangle's diagonals exactly when they share midpoint and length.
Group point pairs by (midpoint, squared length) and check pairs within each group.
All coordinates are integers, so the area is an exact integer — no floating point needed.
